name: lcd12864_st7920
title: 12864 LCD on an ST7920
description: A 128x64 monochrome LCD in serial mode: E is the clock, R/W the data, RS the chip select, PSB to ground

mechanics.do: a board of 93 x 70 mm: it takes a frame of its own, 110 x 80 mm in the time clock, on four M2 screws

lcd.notes: V0 on the module sets the contrast. The viewing angle of the blue negative is poor from below.

mechanics.by: Anton: the board measured, and the printed frame of ~/freecad/tc-eth-poe holds it
mechanics.notes: The size of the holes, 3 mm, is assumed in the model. window_mm is the opening of the frame, not the area of the pixels, which is not measured.

levels.source: A 5 V module; the 3.3 V lines of an ESP32 drive it in tc-eth-p4. Not measured.
